تختزلن (form VIII)
# تَخْتَزِلْنَ (taḵtazilna) /tax.ta.zil.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَزَلَ (iḵtazala)
# تُخْتَزَلْنَ (tuḵtazalna) /tux.ta.zal.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَزَلَ (iḵtazala)
